title: Bank Customer Churn Prediction (ANN)
description: Predicts bank customer churn to improve retention and prevent revenue loss using an Artificial Neural Network.
problem: Banks lose significant revenue when customers leave unnoticed. Manual customer retention tracking fails to detect complex non-linear behavioral patterns before churn occurs.
solution: Built an end-to-end Deep Learning pipeline using Keras/TensorFlow. Trained a multi-layer ANN with EarlyStopping, feature scaling, and category encoding, deployed as an interactive Streamlit web application.

title: Fruit Freshness Classifier (CNN)
description: Automated computer vision system using Convolutional Neural Networks to inspect and classify fruit freshness.
problem: Manual food quality inspection in agriculture, supply chains, and retail is slow, costly, and subjective.
solution: Developed a 14-class CNN image classifier with 99.01% test accuracy using Conv2D, Batch Normalization, and Dropout layers. Features top-3 confidence scores and instant Streamlit image analysis.

title: Enterprise E-Commerce AI Retention Engine
description: Full-stack ML engine processing 540,000+ retail transactions for customer RFM segmentation, churn prediction, and CLTV forecasting.
problem: Traditional e-commerce analytics only identify lost customers post-churn, resulting in reactive interventions and wasted ad spend.
solution: Engineered a multi-phase system combining K-Means customer clustering, Random Forest churn prediction (with data leakage isolation), and XGBoost regression for lifetime value forecasting.

title: End-to-End Credit Risk Scoring Engine
description: Production REST API for real-time loan default risk probability calculation and automated loan approval decisions.
problem: Financial institutions face heavy loss from false-negative loan approvals due to imbalanced credit risk data.
solution: Trained an XGBoost classification model optimized for Precision, Recall, and ROC-AUC. Serialized scalers/models with Joblib and served real-time score evaluations via a Django REST API.

title: Intelligent Customer Segmentation Engine
description: Interactive unsupervised analytics dashboard grouping customers into actionable business personas using K-Means and the Elbow Method.
problem: Retailers struggle to deliver targeted marketing campaigns without clear, data-driven customer personas.
solution: Implemented K-Means clustering on age, income, and spending data. Proved optimal K=5 mathematically via WCSS Elbow plots and built an interactive 2D customer persona map.

title: Bitcoin Price Prediction & Blockchain Storage
description: Financial time-series predictive analytics system evaluating Linear Regression, ARIMA, and SVR with SPCE dimensionality reduction.
problem: Cryptocurrency price volatility makes market trend forecasting noisy and historical datasets susceptible to tampering.
solution: Applied Subspace Learning (SPCE) to reduce feature space from 6 to 4 dimensions (+12% accuracy gain). Compared LR, ARIMA (96%), and SVM, while retrieving raw records via Web3 Solidity smart contracts.

title: Secure Resume Builder System (AES-256)
description: Full-stack web application enabling custom resume creation with client-side dynamic rendering and encrypted server storage.
problem: Users need structured resume rendering without risking server-side plain text document data exposure.
solution: Built a Django + MySQL web platform using PyAES (AES-256 CTR mode) and PBKDF2 key derivation for decrypt-on-download security. Rendered layouts dynamically via Matplotlib and OpenCV image resizing.
